killedBy: DEV_PRESETS (issue #623) no preset silently loses a value to a rejecting parser
why: A preset naming a versus mode that does not exist. The parser REJECTS an unrecognised value to the flag's default rather than throwing, so the preset still builds a URL, still loads, and simply lands on the shipped mode -- a button labelled '2-player VS' that quietly does something else. Hand-named assertions cannot catch this in general, which is why the killing test is a SWEEP over every preset asserting no `rejected` note, rather than a case per preset.
